meta_title: Smart Gas Heating | Gas Engineer Stoke-on-Trent
meta_description: Smart Gas Heating Ltd is your trusted gas engineer in Stoke-on-Trent. Fast boiler repairs, installations and servicing. Emergency callouts available.
hero_subhead: Boiler broken? We arrive within an hour across Stoke-on-Trent and fix most faults the same day.
services_subhead: From emergency boiler repairs to full system installations, we handle every gas heating need with speed and skill.

services.title: Emergency Boiler Repair
services.desc: Your boiler's packed up? We diagnose and repair most faults same day. No overnight surcharge — same price as standard hours.

services.title: Boiler Installation & Replacement
services.desc: New condensing boilers installed with a 10-year warranty. We'll handle the disconnect, install, and test. Cheaper to run, cleaner, and quieter.

services.title: Annual Boiler Service
services.desc: Keep your boiler efficient and safe with a yearly check. We inspect all components, test for gas leaks, and service the burner.

services.title: Radiator Repairs & Bleeding
services.desc: Cold spots or noisy pipes? We bleed radiators, fix leaks, and balance your heating system to run at full efficiency.

services.title: Central Heating Installation
services.desc: Complete system upgrades from pipework to controls. We design, install, and commission new heating systems that save money on bills.

services.title: Gas Safety Certification
services.desc: Landlords and letting agents — we issue up-to-date Gas Safety Certificates and provide full compliance reports.

about_pullquote: I started this job because I hated seeing people ripped off by cowboys.
about_para_1: Smart Gas Heating was founded in 2013 by Mark Stevens, a Gas Safe Registered engineer with over 15 years' experience in commercial and domestic heating. From a single engineer to a team of four, we've built our reputation on showing up fast, fixing it right, and charging a fair price. We're locals serving locals — you'll recognize the van around Stoke.
about_para_2: Our customers come back because we explain what's wrong in plain English, give you options, and don't rush you into a boiler you don't need yet. We've completed over 1,000 jobs — from student lets to period homes — and we're proud that most of our new work comes from word-of-mouth. Every engineer carries the right parts and tools, so we rarely need a second visit.
reviews_heading: What Stoke-on-Trent Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Boiler stopped working on a Sunday evening. Called Mark and he was here by 8pm. Turned out to be a simple fix but he could have charged me for a full replacement. Didn't — just fixed it and charged me fifty quid. Brilliant service, exactly what you hope for.
reviews.author: David P.

reviews.text: Had a new boiler installed last month. The lads were polite, professional, explained everything as they went. System's running quieter than the old one and I can already tell the bills will drop. They even left the house cleaner than they found it. Would definitely recommend.
reviews.author: Jennifer M.

reviews.text: As a landlord I need someone reliable for gas checks. Mark's done my two properties every year since 2016. Always on time, thorough, and the tenants say they're friendly. Makes my life easy.
reviews.author: Robert T.
